notes.title: v0.5.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
General

 Reworked attack queue system for real-time adjustments during battles.
 Quick Attack now adds to Attack stats.
 Modified attack check and removal process, now after attack queue creation.


Attacks
Added

 Arcane Explosion - Up to 3 Dice: Σ Range Damage to player. If Triple, apply Σ Blind.
 Blizzard - 2 Dice: Deal Σ Damage and reduce Strength by Σ / 2.
 Chain Lightning - 2 Dice: Σ Damage. If Σ >= 8, trigger the next attack in the queue.
 Frost Nova - 2 Dice: Σ Damage. Apply Σ / 2 Weakness.
 Infernal Blaze - 1 Dice: Σ Damage. Apply Σ / 2 Burn.
 Mystic Flare - 1 Dice: Σ Damage. If Σ is even, apply 50 Blind else gain 50 Precision.
 Mystic Shield - 2 Dice: Gain Σ x 2 Block. If Pair, also gain 1 Fortified.
 Razor Quills - 2 Dice: Σ Damage. Gain Σ Thorn.
 Sandstorm - 2 Dice: Apply Σ Blind to player and remove all player's Strength.
 Shadow Lash - Up to 3 Dice: Σ Damage. If Pair, apply 1 Weakness and 1 Fatigue.
 Soul Drain - 1 Dice: Player loses Σ Strength, unit gains Σ Strength.
 Tempest Fury - 3 Dice: Σ Damage. If 3 Straight, gain 1 Endurance.
 Titan's Barrier - Gain 500 Block
 Toxic Burst - 4 Dice: Σ Damage. If Triple, Apply Σ Poison.
 Toxic Nova - 2 Dice: Σ Damage. If Pair, add Poisonous Spit to all player items.
 Volcanic Eruption - 2 Dice: Σ x 2 Damage. Apply Σ / 2 Burn and remove 1 Fortified from player.


Change

 Quick Strike - trigger an additional attack. -> gain 1 Attack.

notes.title: v0.5.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
General

 Added new UI layout.
 Blessings Reward Window will now be in a card layout.
 Corruption Penalty Window will now be in a card layout.
 Items will have different borders on uses depending on reload or not.
 Leaderboard will now slowly load in instead of halting the game for a second.


Dice

 Added Enchantment on Dice
 Dice will have a shimmer effect when Enchanted.
 Removed 50-50 Dice from Upgrades.


Enchantment

 Aloe Vera - Remove 1 Burn when used.
 Armor - Add Block 3 Block when used.
 Ascendant Roll - When rolled, increase the value by 1, maxing out at the dice's maximum
 Detox - Remove 1 Poison when used.
 Energy - Remove 1 Weakness when used.
 Gamble - Dice only result in its minimum or maximum value.
 Health - Heal 1 health when used.
 Locked - When used, this dice gain 1 Lock.
 Strength - Gain 1 Strength when used.


Events

 Shrine now has two options, Pray and Enchant.
 Added Enchant to Town.


Blessing

 Archer's Blessing - removed Fatigue and changed to "On roll each Triple give +1 Attack."


Bug

 Fixed spelling error on Savage Precision
 Multiple Unit Blessings now have the correct type.
 Fixed Endless Mode not starting correctly.

notes.title: v0.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Feature
Endless Mode
Once the Void Dragon is slain you can enter Endless Mode and play harder and harder units until you die.

Leaderboard
There will be leaderboards for each character

 Corrupted Champions
 Endless Champions


Blessings
Unique Character Blessing

 Archer's Blessing - On roll each Triple give +2 Attack.
 Knight's Blessing - Whenever you take damage, gain 1 Fortified.
 Samurai's Blessing - Whenever you deal damage, apply 2 Poison.
 Sorcerer's Blessing - On roll each Pair give +1 Strength. On roll each Triple give +1 Endurance.
 Traveler's Blessing - Select an additional option in Town. May select multiple of same in Town.


Shrine

 Blinded Precision - Whenever Enemy take damage, gain 1 Counter on Blinded Precision. At start of turn gain 1 Precision for each Counter on Blinded Precision. At start of turn gain 1 Blind for each Counter on Blinded Precision.
 Champions's Guilt - Whenever you apply Fatigue to Enemy, also apply 1 Weakness.
 Flum Block - If your total roll is equal or less than 20, gain 5 Block for each Dice you own.


Elite

 Logical Thinking - Start with 1 Attack for each empty slot.
 Resilient Heart - Whenever you gain a Debuff, gain 1 Counter on Resilient Heart. At end of combat remove all Counter and gain 1 Health for each Counter removed.
 Shadow's Grace - Every time an enemy misses an attack, add 1 Counter to Shadow's Grace. At the start of combat, Enemy gain Blind equal to the number of Counters on Shadow's Grace.


Boss

 Echoing Exertion - Gain 1 Fatigue whenever you use an Item, but the Item is triggered twice.


Changes

 Renamed Grinded Feather to Grinding Monstera


Corruption
Endless Corruption
These are only selectable when Endless mode is active

 Clot Blood - Enemy gain 10% Health
 Hellish Precision - Each enemy gain +1 Attack.
 Demonspike Surge - Each enemy gain +2 Thorn.
 Dice Upgrade - Upgrade a random dice on each enemy type.
 Dreadlord's Might - Each enemy gain +1 Strength.
 Hellish Precision - Each enemy gain +10 Precision.
 Netherstone Bastion - Each enemy gain +1 Fortified.
 Unholy Stamina - Each enemy gain +1 Endurance.


Endless Void Corruption
Each time the Void Dragon is killed these Corruptions will be added.

 Dice Transform - Upgrade all enemy dice twice.
 Iron Blood - Enemy gain +500 Health.


Attacks

 Stun - Does nothing. Remove Stun.


Audio

 Added new music for menu
 Added unique battle music for each world.
